role_goal: restore server-kfrm Agent Host heartbeat through an approved operator channel, then verify read-only probe evidence
goal: Coordinate a remote-first recovery envelope for server-kfrm from the fresh SRE/control node home, not from stale server-kfrm. Start with read-only Control Plane checks for /health, /v1/nodes, and /v1/tasks/KOL-SERVER-KFRM-PROBE-20260629. Use the approved operator channel to request or perform the Agent Host recovery on host server-kfrm only if explicit operator approval is present in the task context. After the Agent Host is restored, verify that node_id server-kfrm reports fresh=true and health=online, then allow the existing read-only probe KOL-SERVER-KFRM-PROBE-20260629 to lease and complete on server-kfrm. Do not duplicate-submit the probe if it already exists. Do not run FormulaLM, app QA, Mac compute, queue surgery, broad workload drains, direct Redis/spool edits, SSH product-path work, or manual Control Plane lease edits. Return an artifact report with the preflight snapshot, approved operator action reference, fresh heartbeat evidence, probe state/result_reference, stop-gate decisions, and rollback notes.
execution_sequence: Confirm this task is leased by target_node home and not by server-kfrm or mesh-server-kfrm.
Record read-only Control Plane snapshot before any operator action.
Confirm KOL-SERVER-KFRM-PROBE-20260629 exists and do not create a duplicate task.
If explicit operator approval is missing, stop with a blocker artifact and exact approval request.
Through the approved operator channel, restore or bootstrap Agent Host on host server-kfrm so node_id server-kfrm resumes heartbeat.
Verify server-kfrm fresh=true, health=online, draining=false, active_task is safe, and capabilities include read_only_probe and generic_implementation.
Let the existing read-only probe lease on server-kfrm and complete with node-local artifact evidence.
Collect the probe task status/result_reference and write a concise artifact report.
stop_gates: Stop if the task is not leased by allowed_nodes=[home].
Stop if server-kfrm or mesh-server-kfrm attempts to execute this orchestration task.
Stop if Control Plane /health is not ok.
Stop if executor node server-kfrm cannot be distinguished from mesh-server-kfrm.
Stop if KOL-SERVER-KFRM-PROBE-20260629 is absent, retargeted away from server-kfrm, or has a mismatched idempotency key.
Stop if explicit operator approval for live Agent Host recovery is absent.
Stop if the only available path requires unapproved SSH/SCP, direct Redis/spool edits, manual lease edits, queue surgery, cancel, retry, requeue, drain, un-drain, deploy, or broad workload mutation.
Stop if FormulaLM, LLM benchmark, app QA, product QA, browser QA, or Mac compute is requested before fresh heartbeat and completed read-only probe.
Stop if fresh heartbeat appears only on mesh-server-kfrm and not on executor node_id server-kfrm.
Stop if the probe leases on any node other than server-kfrm.
Stop if the result artifact would expose secrets, auth files, raw private logs, or unapproved local paths.
prohibited_actions: run app QA, product QA, browser QA, or heavy build workloads
use Mac/local compute as a substitute for server-kfrm recovery
perform queue surgery, direct Redis edits, spool edits, manual lease edits, cancel, retry, requeue, drain, or un-drain
target this orchestration task at stale server-kfrm or mesh-server-kfrm
publish secrets, auth material, raw private logs, or unapproved node-local paths
acceptance: Task is leased by allowed SRE/control node home, not stale server-kfrm or mesh-server-kfrm.
Artifact report includes preflight Control Plane snapshot and confirms executor server-kfrm is distinct from mesh-server-kfrm.
Agent Host recovery is performed only through an approved operator channel with explicit approval recorded in the report.
server-kfrm reports fresh=true and health=online after recovery, with heartbeat_at newer than the preflight snapshot.
Existing read-only probe KOL-SERVER-KFRM-PROBE-20260629 completes with lease_owner/server evidence for server-kfrm.
Probe result_reference or artifact reference is recorded.
No FormulaLM, app QA, Mac compute, queue surgery, SSH product-path work, direct Redis/spool edits, duplicate probe submit, or broad workload mutation is performed.
Rollback/stop-gate notes are included even if recovery stops before mutation.

must_include: operator approval reference or missing-approval blocker

source.routing_rationale: home is documented as fresh, non-draining, and SRE/control capable; server-kfrm and mesh-server-kfrm are stale and must not execute this orchestration envelope.
